correctness.rationale: For odd characteristic other than five, the invertible antipodal substitution and exact quintic expansion reduce equal sums at fixed nonzero \(s\) to the union of \(x=\pm y\) and the nonzero-radius circle \(x^2+y^2=-s^2/2\). Their exact counts \(2q-1\), \(q-\chi(-1)\), and \(2(1+\chi(-1))\) yield the second moment \(3(q-1-\chi(-1))\). The even-quartic root structure and exceptional root \(x=0\) determine odd multiplicities; the first and second moments force \(k_2\) and \(k_4\). The zero-sum and characteristic-five cases are checked separately. Character orthogonality gives the normalization \(q^{-2}E(C_5)\). The exact script exhaustively verifies all slices for 17 selected prime and extension fields; finite corroboration does not replace the unrestricted proof.

value.rationale: The graph \(\{(t,t^5)\}\) is the lowest odd-degree sparse two-coordinate monomial curve whose same-sum collision polynomial acquires a nontrivial conic component. The result completely classifies every nonempty two-sum fiber, not merely one moment; determines exact sumset size and constant-input fourth Fourier moment in all odd finite fields; reveals separate arithmetic effects of \(\chi(-1)\) on energy and \(\chi(-2)\) on support; and isolates a Frobenius-collapse boundary in characteristic five. These structural invariants are natural benchmarks for finite-field convolution and restriction; no sharp arbitrary-input inequality is claimed.
